inspiration.observed_pattern: A SQL function-compatibility query nests LOG2 inside ABS and also evaluates the reciprocal input to compare symmetric logarithmic magnitudes.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored power-profile report. Fixed positive measurements, reciprocal magnitudes, NULL propagation, and rounded LOG2 projections are grouped by sensor family; PostgreSQL casts, FDW wrappers, source table names, and values are not copied.

fixture_notes: Sensor family north has values 1, 2, and 8; family south has 0.5 and 4 plus one NULL. LOG2 exposes negative, zero, and positive signed values, while ABS(LOG2(value)) and ABS(LOG2(1/value)) agree for non-NULL reciprocal pairs.
determinism_notes: Measurement IDs, families, numeric values, reciprocal expression, rounding scale, and ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE power_measurements (measurement_id INT PRIMARY KEY, sensor_family VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, signal_value DOUBLE NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT measurement_id, sensor_family, signal_value, ROUND(LOG2(signal_value), 3) AS signed_log2, ROUND(ABS(LOG2(signal_value)), 3) AS magnitude_log2, ROUND(ABS(LOG2(1 / signal_value)), 3) AS reciprocal_magnitude FROM power_measurements ORDER BY measurement_id

SELECT sensor_family, COUNT(signal_value) AS measured_count, ROUND(AVG(ABS(LOG2(signal_value))), 3) AS mean_magnitude FROM power_measurements WHERE signal_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sensor_family ORDER BY sensor_family

checks.sql: SELECT measurement_id, sensor_family, signal_value FROM power_measurements ORDER BY measurement_id
